issuer: the North Dakota Department of Transportation, Driver License Division
note: NDDOT's licence requirements page (read 2026-10-30) gives a non-commercial licence at $15.00 and the minimum driving age as 16, a restricted licence being available from 15; a licence held from 16 is kept as the full one (the restricted licence of 15 isn't held). The ID card page says an ID card may be had at any age and is free from 18 ($8.00 under 18), so the card is kept with no age at no fee (the adult's case). Neither term was read, so both are null.

sources.title: NDDOT, Driver License Requirements
sources.said: The minimum driving age in North Dakota is 16. ... Non-commercial permit or license: $15.00

sources.title: NDDOT, Driver License
sources.said: The minimum driving age in North Dakota is 16, but a resident can obtain a restricted license at the age of 15.

sources.title: NDDOT, ID Card Requirements
sources.said: ou may obtain an ID card at any age. ... If you are under 18 years old: $8.00 If you are 18 years or older: No fee
